title: Network-initiated de-registration procedure completion by the network
text: The network shall stop timer T3522 upon receipt of the DEREGISTRATION ACCEPT message. The network shall enter state 5GMM-DEREGISTERED for 3GPP access if the de-registration request is for 3GPP access. The network shall enter state 5GMM-DEREGISTERED for non-3GPP access if the de-registration request is for non-3GPP access. The network shall enter state 5GMM-DEREGISTERED for both 3GPP access and non-3GPP access if the de-registration request is for both 3GPP access and non-3GPP access
